### Mechanism of the Week: The Hallmarks of Aging
The hallmarks of aging are a set of twelve biological processes whose age-associated changes meet three criteria: they appear with advancing age, their experimental accentuation speeds aging, and their therapeutic targeting can slow, stop, or reverse aspects of aging in model systems.
